verdict.rationale: Modal documents running sandboxes at large concurrency, with programmatic scaling to hundreds of thousands of concurrent environments and thousands of concurrent GPU runs. That gives real fan-out across many workloads at once. However, the evidence shows no explicit bulk-operation primitive, such as a batch command that acts on many sandboxes or items in one call, so bulk handling appears to depend on SDK-driven concurrency rather than a dedicated feature. Missing for 10: a documented bulk/batch operation API (e.g., exec/terminate/list across many sandboxes in one call), CLI bulk commands, and independent hands-on corroboration of bulk workflows.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
